planned_insertions.anchor: capture noisily g1_fit, method(`method') id(psid) time(source_year)
planned_insertions.text: * WFDOC: Risk/exit hanya diteruskan pada OP; selectionmode synthetic_disappearance menandai event panel fiktif development dan tidak menyebut penutupan perusahaan aktual.
* WFDOC: e(sample) menandai baris yang benar-benar masuk dynamic fit; sidecar tetap dibuat untuk seluruh baris domain current-year sehingga prediction di luar fit tidak hilang.
* WFDOC: Ringkasan fit_results mempertahankan sel success, failure dan support skip beserta tahun fit, rank serta normalizer pooled; tidak ada variant yang dipilih berdasarkan hasil.
* WFDOC: Hanya primary fit_success yang membentuk cell resampling; variant sensitivitas dan primary yang gagal tidak dapat ditutup oleh bootstrap cell lain.
* WFDOC: Opsi method, proxy, eligibility, kalender dan seed mengulang kontrak point fit pada setiap full-process draw; bootstrap ini eksploratif dan tetap bersyarat pada linkage fiktif.
* WFDOC: File draw hanya dipromosikan ke outputs setelah panggilan selesai dengan rc=0; ringkasan tetap mencatat rc dan jumlah sukses bila cell gagal.
* WFDOC: Dataset primary untuk distribusi hanya mengambil in_fit; attachment di bagian akhir sengaja membaca seluruh primary prediction agar baris domain di luar fit tetap dapat diaudit.
* WFDOC: summarize, detail dan histogram memakai seluruh nilai finite dalam group yang sama; tidak ada trimming, dan n menjadi penyebut statistik maupun share bin.
* WFDOC: Reshape memakai obs_id×source_year×sector×sample_id sehingga metode dibandingkan pada baris sumber yang sama; mask pairwise dan four_method tetap dua cakupan berbeda.
* WFDOC: Sidecar attachment mempertahankan semua primary prediction yang tersedia, bukan hanya in_fit; flag pred dan in_fit memisahkan ketersediaan residual dari keikutsertaan estimasi.

planned_insertions.text: * WFDOC: Merge m:1 hanya melampirkan y/l/k dari N01 ke primary prediction yang punya source row; assert dan keep(3) mencegah linkage prediction tanpa observasi sumber.

planned_insertions.text: * WFDOC: Inner join satu-ke-satu mempertahankan hanya psid×sektor×metode×sampel yang memiliki kedua endpoint; syarat berikut menolak bridge kalender melalui 2016.

* WFDOC: change dihitung pada skala measure yang dipilih; ratio hanya digunakan untuk index dan hitungan arah memakai perubahan yang sama pada pasangan terpilih.
* WFDOC: Mean, rasio dan korelasi tepat hanya dilepas saat N_pairs≥5; hitungan negatif/nol/positif dan bin tetap menjadi diagnostics agregat.
* WFDOC: Group means memakai log y/l/k pada kelompok prediction; identitas raw=mean_y−beta_L×mean_l−beta_K×mean_k diuji sebelum centering dengan normalizer pooled yang sama.

proof_plan.before_sha_rule: Before applying, recompute every before_sha256 from the listed source path and stop if any differs. The retained baseline_snapshot is the byte-for-byte comparison source.

stata: blank lines only when explicitly present in the plan
python: blank lines only when explicitly present in the plan

forbidden_changes: deleting or altering any baseline executable line
altering an existing comment or docstring
inserting a Stata comment between a continued statement line ending /// and its continuation
changing whitespace on an existing non-comment line
running Stata or regenerating analytical outputs as part of the comment pass
proof_plan.stata_proof: Compare baseline snapshot and post-apply source with a line diff; every removed/modified line must be absent, every added line must match an approved comment text, and the normalized executable sequence must be byte-identical after removing comment-only/blank lines. Explicitly scan each insertion predecessor and reject a predecessor ending in ///.
proof_plan.python_proof: Compare baseline snapshot and post-apply source with tokenize/AST checks. Require all added lines to be approved # comments, no baseline non-comment token deletion or alteration, and ast.dump(ast.parse(source), include_attributes=False) to match exactly. Keep shebang/docstrings as baseline tokens and do not rewrite them.

scientific_concerns_for_root.note: The code intentionally treats reported source-year capital as an assumed December stock and reported additions as a separate investment candidate. Documentary flags remain metadata; this is development compatibility, not source verification or real TFP.

Risk intervals and disappearance indicators are generated from official synthetic_development assignments. They must remain labelled as development events, not observed firm closure or actual linkage.
The centered residual index uses one pooled dynamic mean per sector×method×sample across supported dynamic years; source_year=0 in deep outputs is a pooled label, not a calendar year.
